brand.description:
Identifier of the brand to which this client
is attached to. The format is
'projects/{project_number}/brands/{brand_id}'.
brand.rationale: Identifier referencing the OAuth brand the client belongs to. We don't constrain references to other resources, and a generic policy cannot know the correct brand for a given team/project.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

display_name.description: Human-friendly name given to the OAuth client.
display_name.rationale: Cosmetic display name for the OAuth client. It is descriptive metadata; a generic policy cannot meaningfully constrain free-text names and enforcing one secures nothing.
